query: Run Phase 3: build the AS-IS baseline regression suite. .indexing-kb/, docs/analysis/01-functional/, and docs/analysis/02-technical/ are all ready.
expected_behavior: Reads supervisor-protocol.md and wave-overview.md before dispatching any worker
Runs fixture-builder in W0 (before any test writers) to establish shared fixtures
Dispatches one usecase-test-writer instance per use case from Phase 1 (fan-out pattern, not a single invocation)
baseline-runner (W2) runs only after all W1 usecase-test-writer workers have completed
baseline-challenger runs in W3 (always ON, never opt-in)
Writes _meta/phase-verification-report.md (Wave 3b) after the challenger
Updates _meta/manifest.json after every wave with timing fields populated
Detects whether pytest is available and switches to write-only mode if the environment is not ready
Never modifies AS-IS source code even if a test fails due to a latent bug
Marks medium/low severity test failures as xfail with an AS-IS bug note, never silently deletes them
Escalates critical/high severity failures to the user without auto-resolving or auto-marking xfail
All file content written via Write tool. Never via Bash heredoc, echo redirect, tee, or printf > file

query: Produce the AS-IS baseline tests. Existing tests/baseline/ and oracle snapshots already exist from a previous run
expected_behavior: Detects existing tests/baseline/ and oracle artifacts before dispatching any worker
Asks the user explicitly: skip / re-run / revise (never auto-overwrites)
Default recommendation offered to the user is skip (oracle is the Phase 4 Step 6 equivalence reference)
If user selects re-run, warns explicitly that regenerating the oracle resets the Phase 4 Step 6 equivalence reference and requires explicit confirmation
Does not proceed past the detection gate without an explicit user choice

query: Run the baseline tests. The baseline-runner reports a CRITICAL failure in the authentication module
expected_behavior: Does NOT mark the critical failure as xfail
Does NOT attempt to patch the AS-IS source code
Escalates to the user with the full failure context (module, test name, traceback summary)
Does not declare Phase 3 complete while a critical failure remains unresolved
Stops further dispatch until the user provides a triage decision
